title: Verify Skill Agent output with the executing executor
goal: Make SkillAgentOrchestrator use SkillRuntime.executeVerified so the executor that produced output also verifies it before the Agent returns success.
context: SkillAgentOrchestrator currently calls execute() and then verify() as separate operations. Each operation resolves the executor independently, so registry changes between calls could cause output to be verified by a different implementation. SkillRuntime already provides executeVerified with same-instance verification.
forbidden_changes: Do not bypass policy or Agent scope checks.
Do not return output when verification fails.
Do not change executor registry first-registration-wins behavior.
Do not modify App/ or Xcode project files.
acceptance_criteria: Verifier rejection maps to SkillAgentOrchestratorError.verificationFailed for compatibility.
A regression test proves Skill Agent execution fails when its executor rejects output.
Existing Agent scope, policy, and cancellation behavior remain unchanged.
verification: Confirm Swift package tests + repository integrity, macOS Xcode iOS arm64 build/unsigned IPA, and validate-contract CI gates.
recovery: Revert this single logical commit if existing Skill Agent error contracts or verified execution behavior regress.
